title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_cher_monde_by_toby_little_5t01r (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_cher_monde_by_toby_little_5t01r' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but due to potential full control by an attacker, removal may not eliminate all malicious components.
